gates.unit: node --test tests/battle-*.test.mjs, the named test and no other

unit.name: the call shuts by a third of the walk, too late for a man answering at the last minute
unit.expect: answered at any time the call is open - even the last minute, on foot or on the horse - the man is with the men before first light, and fights
failed: answered at any time the call is open - even the last minute, on foot or on the horse - the man is with the men before first light, and fights

unit.name: somebody reaching town after the call shut is asked anyway
unit.expect: once the call shuts it cannot be answered, and a family reaching town too late to catch the men is told so and never asked
failed: once the call shuts it cannot be answered, and a family reaching town too late to catch the men is told so and never asked

unit.name: the river holds the man going with the men at the ford
unit.expect: the river over the ford does not hold somebody going with the men: they crossed that night, and so does he
failed: the river over the ford does not hold somebody going with the men: they crossed that night, and so does he

unit.name: a man in the line can be ordered home before it is over
unit.expect: nobody with the men can be sent anywhere else until they come back with them
failed: nobody with the men can be sent anywhere else until they come back with them

unit.name: a Host's time jump runs through the fight
unit.expect: a Host's time jump stops at the fight and never passes it
failed: a Host's time jump stops at the fight and never passes it

unit.name: a named man is given reconstructed words
unit.expect: an engagement is checked when it loads: documented words carry a claim, a named man speaks nothing reconstructed, nobody falls who may not
failed: an engagement is checked when it loads: documented words carry a claim, a named man speaks nothing reconstructed, nobody falls who may not

unit.name: the old dawn moment kept, so the director and the fight disagree about first light
unit.expect: the fight stands on the director's clock: its phases date the old moments, and nothing moves the day
failed: the fight stands on the director's clock: its phases date the old moments, and nothing moves the day

unit.name: an old save is never given the fight
unit.expect: a class saved in the middle of the fight reopens in the middle of it, and an old save with no record of it gains one from the clock
failed: a class saved in the middle of the fight reopens in the middle of it, and an old save with no record of it gains one from the clock

unit.name: the fight run three times faster than its steps, over in about two real minutes
unit.expect: the fighting plays three to six real minutes at the Study pace on both maps, and the clock never runs faster for it
failed: the fighting plays three to six real minutes at the Study pace on both maps, and the clock never runs faster for it

unit.name: a phase's later lines are sent before they are said
unit.expect: a page is sent nothing that has not happened yet: no later line, shot, fall or phase
failed: a page is sent nothing that has not happened yet: no later line, shot, fall or phase

unit.name: every family is sent the fight, wherever its people are
unit.expect: the Host and the families with somebody there watch it live; the town, the farm, a spectator and a reconnect are sent nothing
failed: the Host and the families with somebody there watch it live; the town, the farm, a spectator and a reconnect are sent nothing

unit.name: the alert is put again every tick
unit.expect: the family whose man is going is alerted through him before contact, once; nobody else is
failed: the family whose man is going is alerted through him before contact, once; nobody else is

unit.name: the town hears every shot of the gun, not the report once for each moment
unit.expect: the town hears the gun - twice, in words - and never the fight; the farm hears nothing
failed: the town hears the gun - twice, in words - and never the fight; the farm hears nothing

unit.name: the account does not say why it ended as it did
unit.expect: afterwards the family is told through its man what happened, what he did and why it ended so, and the journal keeps it
failed: afterwards the family is told through its man what happened, what he did and why it ended so, and the journal keeps it

unit.name: volunteers laid out on a grid
unit.expect: volunteers are laid out loose and regulars in ranks, and no two loose men stand on one spot
failed: volunteers are laid out loose and regulars in ranks, and no two loose men stand on one spot

unit.name: the smoke ignores the wind
unit.expect: every man fires on his own cycle, again and again, and the smoke gathers, lingers, drifts with the wind and thins when the firing stops
failed: every man fires on his own cycle, again and again, and the smoke gathers, lingers, drifts with the wind and thins when the firing stops

unit.name: the officer says nothing before a volley
unit.expect: the officer gives the words of each volley, and every line is drawn over whoever said it at the moment the tick dated it
failed: the officer gives the words of each volley, and every line is drawn over whoever said it at the moment the tick dated it

unit.name: a side the record forbids is drawn falling
unit.expect: a fall is drawn where the record puts one, carried off after; a side that may not fall never does; a family's man fires with the force
failed: a fall is drawn where the record puts one, carried off after; a side that may not fall never does; a family's man fires with the force

unit.name: the alert is put up over the family's open call
unit.expect: the card: Watch through the family's own person before the fighting, never over an open decision, and the account after
failed: the card: Watch through the family's own person before the fighting, never over an open decision, and the account after

unit.name: a quiet phase marked on the fighting is accepted
unit.expect: a quiet phase is marked in the data only with a step and never on the fighting, and the fighting of every engagement is held
failed: a quiet phase is marked in the data only with a step and never on the fighting, and the fighting of every engagement is held

unit.name: every lead-up held for every class, as before 2026-09-26
expect: a lead-up goes at the ordinary pace with no played family there, and is held at its step while one has somebody there
on a real class the lead-up at Gonzales is held for the family whose man went up the river, and goes faster with nobody there
failed: a lead-up goes at the ordinary pace with no played family there, and is held at its step while one has somebody there
on a real class the lead-up at Gonzales is held for the family whose man went up the river, and goes faster with nobody there

unit.name: a played family's man in the force is not counted there
unit.expect: a lead-up goes at the ordinary pace with no played family there, and is held at its step while one has somebody there
failed: a lead-up goes at the ordinary pace with no played family there, and is held at its step while one has somebody there

unit.name: a played family's man standing with the force before it records him is not there
unit.expect: a played family's man standing with the force before it has recorded him is there, and one half a mile off and more is not
failed: a played family's man standing with the force before it has recorded him is there, and one half a mile off and more is not

unit.name: a quiet phase with nobody there taken in one odd-sized tick the page snaps
expect: a lead-up goes at the ordinary pace with no played family there, and is held at its step while one has somebody there
the fighting is held at its step whoever is there, and a quiet phase before it lands the clock on its first minute
failed: a lead-up goes at the ordinary pace with no played family there, and is held at its step while one has somebody there
the fighting is held at its step whoever is there, and a quiet phase before it lands the clock on its first minute

unit.name: the fighting goes at the class's pace with nobody there
expect: the fighting is held at its step whoever is there, and a quiet phase before it lands the clock on its first minute
on a real class the lead-up at Gonzales is held for the family whose man went up the river, and goes faster with nobody there
failed: the fighting is held at its step whoever is there, and a quiet phase before it lands the clock on its first minute
on a real class the lead-up at Gonzales is held for the family whose man went up the river, and goes faster with nobody there
